questions.stem: What signs indicated a home front was collapsing?

answer.exemplar: Strikes, food riots, desertion, and loss of faith in victory signalled home front collapse even while armies remained in the field.

questions.stem: Why were war debts and reparations economically linked?

answer.exemplar: Allied debts to the US could only be serviced if Germany paid reparations, so a default anywhere broke the circular payment chain.
